title: Clock In
description: Keep track of your friends’ timezones, easier than ever!
body:
![Text reading "Clock In" next to a punch card item.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/61addb1a70ed059ead4545fb8043929c004a4a4a.png) # [![modrinth](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/compact/available/modrinth_vector.svg)](https://modrinth.com/mod/clockin-timezones) [![github](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/compact/available/github_vector.svg)](https://github.com/AussieBox/Clock-In)
[![patreon-singular](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/donate/patreon-singular_vector.svg)](https://patreon.com/aussiebox) [![discord-singular](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/social/discord-singular_64h.png)](https://discord.gg/9m2HXggUHg) # ### Keep track of your friends' timezones, easier than ever!
**Clock In** is a mod that aims to take the pain out of playing Minecraft with people from all around the globe. Currently, the mod adds a system to track timezones with both a command and a clean, concice menu. ### How do I open the menu? Run the command ```/timezone```! It should open the menu back up to where you left it. ### How can I opt out? At the moment, there is no way to opt out of your timezone being tracked. This feature may come later, along with a manual way to set your timezone. Even if it is added, keep in mind that sharing this information is only ever helpful to others. > Your timezone NEVER leaves the device hosting your server. > It's also important to note that all information stored with this mod is available to _anyone_ in _native Java._ This mod does **not** have any ill intentions, we're just trying to help! ### Why is the mod required on the server as well? We need somewhere to store the data! Currently, we don't know how to create a database for this kind of thing (or at all), so your server is going to have to do. Don't worry, it shouldn't take up too much storage!
